text:
olivia: heads up, noticed an edge case when per-route quotas and scoped RBAC intersect. users with routes.read see the quota card but API returns 403 so the frontend shows 0/0 and customers get confused. :confused:
marco: is this purely a UI rendering issue or an API contract problem?
olivia: a bit of both. frontend respects feature flag and renders the card, then fetch to /api/routes/:id/quota returns 403. frontend treats that like missing data.
anya: product ask, should the card be hidden or shown read-only with a tooltip / CTA to request edit access?
sam: prefer read-only for enterprise. Hiding feels like lost telemetry. But backend must return a clear signal that this is read-only vs a real error.
marco: backend change idea: map scope check to an access_level in the response. when user has read-only scopes return 200 {"quota": {...}, "access_level":"read"}. when they can modify return access_level:"write". when they truly lack visibility return 404.
olivia: currently we return 403 with an empty body in many cases. we can change to the mapping you suggest without a major version bump if we keep it additive.
marco: authz middleware already knows allowed_scopes (routes.read, routes.modify). we can translate that to access_level. implementation: api-gw returns 200 + small body shown above when quota exists but user lacks modify.
anya: UX: render metrics, disable edit controls, add "Request edit access" CTA that opens a modal targeted at tenant admins. show a tooltip that explains why fields are disabled.
sam: telemetry: emit event quota_card_rendered with tag access_level=read|write so we can measure how many users see read-only. also sample authz traces (authz_rule applied) at 1% default and allow full sampling per-tenant via feature flag.
marco: agree on sampling. we'll add authz_rule="scope:routes.modify" to sampled traces and expose ?authz_debug=1 for internal sessions.
olivia: tests: add unit tests to authz layer and an integration that simulates old 403 -> new 200(access_level=read) so frontend behavior is deterministic.
marco: i'll push a small backend patch today; e2e and console changes behind a feature flag.
anya: rollout plan: enable backend, deploy console change behind flag, roll to 10% of orgs for 48h, check telemetry and support queue.
sam: create dashboard with ratio (quota_card_rendered:read) / (quota_card_rendered:write) and alert if ratio changes >10% unexpectedly. also track support tickets tagged "quota-view-confusion".
olivia: docs: update Console RBAC page to describe access_level semantics, show screenshots for read-only card, and include support blurb.
marco: edge case: delegated admin flows where a proxy token grants modify but UI is running as user. ensure access_level reflects effective principal used by the UI call, not the proxy's full privileges.
sam: noted. we'll verify token impersonation path.
anya: timeline?
marco: backend PR by EOD tomorrow.
sam: console PR on Thursday, I'll pair with olivia on the modal.
olivia: i'll draft the rollout checklist and ping #release-war-room when ready.
sre-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary flip for feature/console-quota-access-level at 2025-11-02T09:00Z (cancelable within 15m).
marco: PR link when up. olivia please add quick integration test and the telemetry event definition.
olivia: will do. thanks everyone :rocket:
